These 16 native dependency builds additionally completed with -Wall -Wextra -Werror in C; other third-party C builds use upstream positive warnings plus -Werror. Intentional configure availability probes are distinct from real source compilation.
boundaries: Runtime ELF graph includes all installed Qt libraries/plugins, a superset of those used by Emergent.
Kernel/glibc/graphicsdrivers and remaining139 distro package families are inventoried as current; this manifest does not claim every platform package isupgraded.
Dynamically loaded graphics/audio backends can add dependencies beyond ELF DT_NEEDED.
Five optional Qt SQL drivers have unavailable client libraries; default Emergent does not use these plugins.
Bundled Qt/Chromium components must be updated via coherent Qt module builds and verified separately.
